<b>Memoriae</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are learned disciples of [[the Choir]] who were charged to maintain the [[Memorium]] in [[the Citadel]].<ref>Memoria [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Learned disciple of the Choir charged to maintain the Citadel's Memorium."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
As flying enemies, Memoriae often try to maintain an aerial distance from [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], but will close in to perform melee attacks. Memoriae have four moves:
* <b>Double Slash:</b> Performs two outwards horizontal slashes, moving slightly forwards with each slash.
* <b>Voltvessels:</b> Throws a volt orb at Hornet, which bounces around for a few seconds before pausing midair and bursting into a circular electric field. This deals {{Damage|1+1}} to Hornet if she is hit either by the orb itself or by its electric field. This move is often used when Hornet is out of range of their other attacks.
** The orb can also hit other Memoriae and enemies, including the Memoria that threw it, so they will try to fly away if they get too close to an orb or if Hornet knocks it back towards them. The same applies when the [[Voltvessels]] tool is used against Memoriae; however, when the Voltvessels are in spear form, Memoriae do not dodge, since they do not use this form.
* <b>Parry:</b> Raises their baton to block incoming damage from that direction, retaliating with a Double Slash if the parry is struck.
* <b>Evade:</b> Performs a horizontal dash away from Hornet, often used after missing with a Double Slash when she gets too close.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Memoriae have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Our past, remembered...
* These lands, eternal...
* Saved, preserved, perfect...
* What was will not be forgotten...
}}

== Location ==
Memoriae can be found in the [[Memorium]]. 

Initially, a [[Enemy_Gauntlets_(Silksong)#Memorium|gauntlet]] of two can be encountered in a hidden room, guarding the [[Voltvessels]]. In [[Act 3]], an additional [[Black-Threading|black-threaded]] Memoria appears just outside the [[Ventrica]] room.
